text:
camila: Hey all — idea: one-off 'Quick Labs: Inference in Production' webinar aimed at infra/platform engineers. Short, practical, and repo-first. Two parts: Part A = "Tuning for unit cost" (quant, batching, caching). Part B = "Keeping apps online" (routing, canaries, fallback). 40m + 15m Q. Thoughts?

noah: Love it. Keep slides minimal and show 3 reproducible commands they can run after. I'll demo routing + a controlled failover. Need a small prep list for logs and demo tokens.

amar: I'll own the bench narrative. Plan: one slide with per-token cost table, one showing latency vs batch, and a short CSV for marketing to make a one-pager. I'll also prepare 2 eval prompts. ETA Thu.

jules: Ops checklist: reserve a tiny Dedicated pool for dress rehearsal (90m), enable anonymized replay, confirm recording + captions. I'll create the rehearsal runbook with exact host cues.

tess: For lead routing: suggest tags `quicklabs.session=A|B`, `interest=cost|resilience`, `demo=1|0`. Nurture: session-specific follow-up + lab repo link. Also recommend adding campaign param to CRM.

camila: Example tag config to hand to sales/dev:
```
event: quick_labs
session_tag: quicklabs.session
interest_tags: [cost, resilience]
lead_props: [utm_source, campaign, demo]
```
Rehearsal schedule: full dress 5 days prior, smoke check 1h prior, host cue + fallback phrasing included in script. Everyone confirm by EOD Wed.

amar: Confirmed. Pushing bench CSV + slides to drive. Will include a tiny chart comparing dedicated vs hosted throughput for q8 quant.

noah: Demo snippets I want in runbook:
```
# burst profile
redwood-cli gen --model redwood-medium-q8 --profile burst --tokens 512
# flip fallback policy
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-small --threshold-ms 120
```
Add where logs stream and the exact rollback command.

jules: I'll add a "failover cue" section: host reads "Switching to fallback to maintain latency targets  demo continues." Also adding infra contacts and a one-liner to revert routing.

calendar-bot: calendar: placeholders created for Quick Labs Part A & B by camila. Reminders set 72h and 30m before.

camila: Great — action items: camila = landing + social copy Tue, amar = bench slides Thu, noah+jules = runbook + rehearsal reservations Mon, tess = tag spec + nurture Tue. I'll DM a short host script now. :rocket:
